title: Russian State Register of Pesticides and Agrochemicals as tables
description:
The State Catalogue of Pesticides and Agrochemicals Permitted for Use in the Russian Federation is published by the Ministry of Agriculture of Russia as a PDF of 1,837 pages. This dataset is the same content parsed into 11 flat CSV tables (UTF-8): 2,663 pesticide registrations, 15,044 regulation lines (product × crop × target × rate × pre-harvest interval × number of treatments), 1,694 agrochemical registrations with 4,747 regulation lines, reference tables of crops, targets and active ingredients.

Every regulation line keeps the register's own mark of who may use it: agricultural production or personal subsidiary plots (home gardens). A separate table lists what is permitted for home gardens under currently valid registrations. Empty cells mean “not stated in the register”, not zero.

Source: official release of 23.09.2026. Changes between releases: https://agroreglament.ru/obnovleniya/. The official register prevails; check the registration number on the package.
